# React composition patterns (Vercel)

Patterns for flexible React components: compound components, context and fewer boolean props.

- Source: https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills/main/skills/composition-patterns/SKILL.md
- Author: Vercel
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/react-composition-patterns-vercel-d9e9b118

Helps Claude design component APIs that scale, especially when a component has collected too many boolean props. It covers compound components, lifting state into providers, explicit variants and render props, with notes on React 19 changes. Rules are split into separate files with examples, plus a compiled AGENTS.md.

**Try asking:**
- "This Modal has 12 boolean props, refactor it"
- "Design a reusable Tabs component API"
- "Turn this Select into a compound component"

**Source:** [vercel-labs/agent-skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills/tree/HEAD/skills/composition-patterns) · MIT · by Vercel
